headline: City Host PSG, Liverpool Cruise at LASK in Champions League
paragraphs: Wednesday's Champions League fixtures produced the clearest action of the day. Manchester City hosted Paris Saint-Germain, with Jeremy Doku back in the squad; the match was covered separately by Sky, the Guardian and FourFourTwo, though none of those items in the feed confirms a final score. Liverpool, away at LASK in Linz, were reported 'cruising' by Sky, which credited a Bradley Barcola hat-trick; the Guardian also ran a live match blog of the same game, but again no final score is confirmed here.

What is settled: Arsenal beat Lille 3-0 in the Champions League, per Opta Analyst's post-match stats, with second-half substitutes sparking the win; Sky separately credited Bukayo Saka with a goal six minutes into that game, after Mikel Arteta had challenged him to add more goals. What is merely reported, each from a single outlet only: FourFourTwo says Arsenal's Martin Zubimendi has been given an 'opportunity' to move to Real Madrid, and separately that a 'huge' Trent Alexander-Arnold return to Liverpool from Real Madrid 'edges closer.' Neither claim is corroborated elsewhere in today's feed.
